content.short: Galaxia Explorer lets you own unique artifacts in a fully on-chain, Web3 gaming universe with dynamic NFTs.
content.description: Galaxia Explorer invites you to a universe of fully on-chain games, dynamic NFTs, and Web3 adventures. Join a vibrant community, explore a growing collection of experiences and products, and connect with on-chain friends as you play. Developed by Galaxia Studios, it features artifacts that are truly yours: every item is unique and owned by the player. By embracing blockchain technology, Galaxia Explorer enables genuine ownership of virtual assets and opens new possibilities beyond traditional gaming.
content.meta: Galaxia Explorer is an NFT Dapp with on-chain games, dynamic NFTs, and Web3 gaming. Discover Galaxia Explorer and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
